character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Old Kesh, a Kindled hermit and fisherman: a small figure made of river-dark brown-black clay, about 45 px tall, with a few widely spaced amber freckles like small lights, long white hair and a white beard, a patched grey-ochre sailcloth tunic with a wet grey patch, dark trousers and wrapped dark feet. He holds a long wooden casting rod upright at his side. Top-down RPG pixel art seen from a low three-quarter view, light from the top left, a 1 px dark navy-violet outline, two or three shades per material, no dithering, transparent background, no text or letters.
